description: Track what key opinion leaders (KOLs) in your space are posting on LinkedIn and Twitter/X. Surfaces trending narratives, high-engagement topics, and early signals of emerging conversations before they peak. Chains linkedin-profile-post-scraper and twitter-mention-tracker. Use when a marketing team wants to ride trends rather than create them from scratch, or when a founder wants to know which topics are resonating with their audience.
